## Why

Link the task and summarize the user/project problem.

## What changed

Describe user-visible behavior first, then internal changes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Criteria are mapped to evidence in the task.
- [ ] Out-of-scope behavior was not added.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Do not write only “tests pass.”

## Security and data

- [ ] Authentication/authorization/RLS impact reviewed.
- [ ] Cross-user denial behavior tested where relevant.
- [ ] No secrets or real user data added.
- [ ] Migration/recovery behavior documented where relevant.

## AI

- [ ] No model behavior changed, or the task contains a completed AI Necessity Review.
- [ ] Model output is typed and deterministically validated.
- [ ] Context, budget, fallback, and telemetry are documented.

## Experience

- [ ] Loading, empty, error, and success states checked where relevant.
- [ ] Mobile, keyboard, accessibility, and reduced motion checked where relevant.
- [ ] Product/design constitutions followed.

## Handoff and review

- [ ] Implementation handoff completed.
- [ ] `docs/STATUS.md` and durable decisions updated if needed.
- [ ] Independent Codex review requested/completed.
- [ ] BLOCKING and HIGH findings resolved and re-verified.

## Screenshots or recordings

Include before/after evidence for visible changes.
